run_random_baseline: run the random baseline for the K-Module problem with configurable samples and trials
generate_random_config: generate a random pipeline configuration by sampling valid options for each module
score_config: score a pipeline configuration by counting how many modules match the correct config
run_random_search: run random search for a single trial until solution found or max samples reached
calculate_pass_at_k: calculate empirical pass@k metrics from multiple trial results across different k values
